t: This release adds contextual metadata, a feed output type that generates a descriptive summary of your media content along with IAB taxonomy and GARM suitability classifications. It also adds feed resource policies for granting cross-account access to a feed.
Added support for the GetFixture API, enabling customers to retrieve the details of a fixture from its fixture ID, and added the access role ARN to the CreateFeed, GetFeed, and UpdateFeed responses.
Added support for the SearchFixtures API and DataSourceConfiguration, enabling customers to map fixture event data onto clipping outputs for improved feature accuracy.
AWS Elemental Inference now supports graphic composition on cropped video outputs, enabling branded graphics and other visual elements to be overlaid as part of the inference workflow.
Added support for smart subtitles in Elemental Inference, enabling automatic generation of subtitles for media content. Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese.
Initial GA launch for AWS Elemental Inference including capabilities of Smart Crop and Live Event Clipping
